subject: Secure access plan for SOC 2 Type II report (NDA gating + evidence handoff)
messages:
From: Patricia Owens <patricia.owens@finbridge.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.com
Cc: security@finbridge.com
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report access (NDA required)

Hi Jordan,

Following our procurement checklist, FinBridge needs access to Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report for the period Apr 1, 2025 – Mar 31, 2026. Our legal team requires a countersigned NDA before we can receive the full report and any supporting evidence index. A couple of clarifying items so we can scope the request:  

- Do you provide a bridge letter or auditor contact if the report's audit period doesn't align with our evaluation window?
- Can you supply an evidence index (spreadsheet) that describes which artifacts are sharable versus those that remain internal (e.g., internal audit workpapers)?
- What is your preferred secure transfer mechanism for Type II reports (S3 presigned, secure Drive link, or vendor portal)?

We'd like to complete this by the end of next week. Attaching our standard confidentiality addendum for countersignature.

Thanks,
Patricia Owens
Director, Vendor Risk Management
FinBridge
attachments: FinBridge_Conf_Addendum.pdf (pdf)
From: jordan_blake@redwood.com
To: Patricia Owens <patricia.owens@finbridge.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-01T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report access (NDA required)

Patricia — thanks for the clear list. We're happy to proceed and can follow the gated-access flow: NDA countersign first, then provide a redacted report and an evidence index that marks items as "shareable", "summary only", or "internal (not shared)". High-level answers to your bullets below:  

- Bridge letter/auditor contact: We can provide a bridge letter that covers the delta between the audit period and your evaluation window, and the auditor is available to confirm scope. I'll coordinate an auditor contact if you need one.
- Evidence index: We'll deliver an evidence_index.csv that indicates which artifacts we can share and suggested redaction notes.
- Transfer mechanism: We prefer a limited-time, access-controlled Drive share for documents and S3 presigned URLs for large artifacts. For extra-sensitive items, we can open a read-only session in our vendor portal (requires SSO invite).

Next steps I propose:  
1) You return the NDA via DocuSign (or attached PDF) — I'll get it countersigned today from legal.
2) Once countersigned, I'll share the redacted SOC 2 Type II summary and the evidence_index.csv via a restricted Drive link (link TTL = 14 days).
3) If you need auditor contact info or a formal bridge letter, let me know and I'll loop in our auditor and Vivek (security lead) to prep.

I've attached a short redacted summary (SOC2_TypeII_Redwood_Summary_redacted.pdf) that covers scope and key control families so you can preliminarily validate coverage while the NDA is processed.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0134
attachments: SOC2_TypeII_Redwood_Summary_redacted.pdf (pdf)
From: Patricia Owens <patricia.owens@finbridge.com>

Date: 2026-11-02T08:58:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report access (NDA required)

Jordan — attached is the NDA signed by FinBridge (NDA_FinBridge_Redwood_signed.pdf). We used DocuSign; envelope ID 12345ABCD.

A few follow-ups from our side:  
- Please confirm whether the redacted report you sent covers the full control categories we listed (security, availability, confidentiality).
- We will likely need the bridge letter addressing May–Oct 2026 coverage if any of the control tests fall outside our review window. Who at Redwood is the auditor contact?
- For the evidence index: can you indicate which items require an on-site or live demo (e.g., logging console access)?

If you can confirm timing for final delivery and the Drive link TTL, we'll plan our internal review.

Thanks,
Patricia
attachments: NDA_FinBridge_Redwood_signed.pdf (pdf)
From: jordan_blake@redwood.com
To: Patricia Owens <patricia.owens@finbridge.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-03T15:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report access (NDA required)

Patricia — great, thanks for returning the signed NDA. We've countersigned on our side (attached) and initiated the secure share. Summary of actions completed/next steps:  

- Countersigned NDA: attached (NDA_FinBridge_Redwood_signed.pdf).
- Redacted report: the short summary I shared covers security, availability, confidentiality; full redacted PDF will be uploaded to Drive by EOD.
- Evidence index: uploaded as evidence_index_20261103.csv and includes a column "access_mode" with values: shareable, summary_only, internal. Rows flagged "on-site/demo" denote artifacts that require a live session (we list examples like log retention exports and privileged access workflows).
- Bridge letter and auditor contact: Vivek will draft the bridge letter for the May–Oct 2026 window and introduce you to our auditor (KPMG team lead: Sandra Meyers, sandra.meyers@kpmg.com) if you want direct confirmation.
- Transfer details: Drive share created with viewer-only link and 14-day TTL. For any large artifacts we will provide S3 presigned URLs. If you require enterprise file transfer, Marcus can open a temporary vendor portal session.

Please confirm the email address(es) you'd like for the Drive access (single email is fine) and whether you prefer the auditor intro now or after your internal review.

Thanks — looping Vivek and Laura to track evidence requests and scheduling.

Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
